label: mid original phase, inputs b/e/l/s/h/z after several h/x tokens
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (0.03% of steps). Fires only in the original input phase, at positions 3-6 (about 80% of mass at t=4-5), never at the delimiter or during copy. The current input is usually b, e, l, s, h or z (b and e have the highest lift), and earlier inputs usually include h (prev2_tok=h has 17x lift and holds 54% of mass) and often x. The strongest activations come after several h/x tokens, e.g. 2 x h h [s]. The predicate captures about 63% of activation mass on dev, but precision is about 10%: most steps with this context do not fire, so the unit seems to depend on a finer joint hidden-state condition than this token-history description. It does not fire at t<2, at t>=8, in the delimiter or copy phases, or on most digits.
